import sqlite3

def count_active_users(db_path):
    conn = sqlite3.connect(db_path)
    cursor = conn.cursor()
    cursor.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE active = 1")
    result = cursor.fetchone()[0]
    conn.close()
    return result
